author: LizardKing69
quote: 30FPS in 2026 is unacceptable for an $80 game. The story starts off very slow with no action and the controls are very stiff. Driving is worse than before and looking around while walking/driving makes the frames drop considerably. Explosions and gun fights are worse. Did the critics actually play this game? The graphics are jaw dropping, nothing else is.
